wholePhysicalScope: The existing hotel is identified by its mapped name and distinct building entity. The nineteenth-century photograph-derived engraving constrains the original frontage and side proportions. Present outline is the positional tie.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the original hotel’s slate cross gables, dormer, chimneys, porch and window bay.
limitations: The model depicts the 1877 exterior described in the story. The later enlargement and present additions are from a different phase.
The original geometry is an estimate registered to the surviving inn. Lake-facing elevations and exact chimneys, masonry tones, roof details and glazing are interpreted.
